target_customer: Industrial wholesale distributors (HVAC/R, plumbing, electrical) and manufacturers' reps
problem: Counter and inside sales reps spend time turning complex customer requests, RFQs and spec sheets into accurate quotes and orders.
business_model: B2B SaaS for AI quoting, sales agent, CPQ and AP automation, integrated with distributor ERPs
product_category: Vertical AI sales and quoting for industrial distribution

founders.name: Jason Sullivan
founders.background_notes: CTO at Elementus, tech lead at Coatue, former credit derivatives trader.

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM quoting over messy catalogs and ERP data with real time pricing and availability needs solid integration work with fragmented distributor systems.

defensibility.rationale: Deep ERP integrations (Epicor, Infor, NetSuite, SAP) and domain product data create lock-in, though rivals and ERP vendors offer similar AI.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: ERP vendors later shipped AI agents (Epicor Sept 2025, Infor 2026), so incumbents did move into the wedge after founding.

market_need_then: Industrial distribution is large, run on legacy ERPs and manual quoting; no spend data from 2022 to 2024 was found beyond trade press interviews.

branding.domain_note: Uses distro.app; a DISTRO trademark was registered March 2026 to Distribution AI Inc.

identity.voice_and_tone: Workmanlike and rep focused; calls its product a complete AI wingman for sales reps

branding.brand_signature: Complete AI wingman positioning for counter reps
branding.community_and_virality: Trade press and association listings (NAED, ASA, ISA) show industry visibility.

brand_strength.rationale: Visible in distribution trade groups, but the name is generic and shared with other software called Distro.

outcome_analysis: Distro is an active YC S24 company building AI quoting and sales tools for industrial distributors, with a team of 11 and integrations across major ERPs. Funding is only seen on aggregators with conflicting dates, so traction cannot be judged from public data. Incumbent ERP vendors and several startups have since entered the same space.
notes: No competitor source dated near mid 2024 was found, so the list is empty; Conexiom, BoltWise, InstaLILY, Endeavor and Canals appear only in 2025 and 2026 pages. Seed dated Jun or Sep 2024 on aggregators with investors (Lighthouse Ventures, YC, FundersClub, Pioneer Fund) listed by one source; amount and round unverified, so not recorded. A $500K YC total appears on another aggregator. Completeness pass: a seed dated 2024-06 with no amount is recorded from Seedtable alone, a single database; Startups.fm lists 500K total from Y Combinator.
